items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: when I’m playing Jerry Lee’s music or something there’s things about him that obviously you just ingest.

ctx.x: Has anybody ever — this is obviously a silly question, but has anybody ever said, “Well you should try to act like Benny Goodman.”

No one’s ever told me that I should. You know I’ve worn the same haircut since I was nine. I needed glasses when I was 10. So obviously that was Benny’s look, but I think that when you have your heroes you pick up their mannerisms whether you realize it or not. You know and so you know there are a lot of the ways that Benny played or that he smiled when he played, I think that you just pick up on those things. Obviously also when I’m playing Jerry Lee’s music or something there’s things about him that obviously…

Yes I think so. I mean there’s — the stories about him are — have been around forever. And everybody seems to have one. Every once in a while you talk to somebody like Bucky Pizzarelli never had an issue with Benny Goodman. He just liked him a lot and they got along swell.
